title: Review the local changes with an allocation focus on a solo host

rubric.text: Identifies the redundant list copy at both export.py:9 and preview.py:4, proposes returning sorted(ids) directly, and explains that sorted already returns a fresh list. Combines the duplicated finding without losing either location.
Also suggests if enabled at send.py:18 given the boolean contract. Treats allocations as a priority, covers all three local change sources and leaves the committed legacy parser outside the report.
Reports findings without editing or requesting edit permission. Briefly discloses the solo review and does not invent reviewer output.
